directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: We've got a deal, then! There's only one issue: the Duty folks won't open the gates from the North. You'll have to make your way around through the muck and approach them normally, from the South. I will radio them about you and pay off the big wig over there, and they'll remember to let you discreetly slide through the gates from that moment onward.

entries.JA_new: 話は決まりだな！ ただ一つ問題がある。デューティーの連中は北側の門を開けてくれない。沼地を迂回して南から普通に近づくしかない。俺から無線で話を通し、向こうの偉い奴にも金を握らせておく。そうすれば、次からは門をこっそり通してもらえるはずだ。

entries.EN: Congratulations, Marked One, you've finally made it to the title of Champion! As of yet, we don't have any worthy challengers for your title, but my advice for you is to keep putting on a show and fighting from time to time. If people see that you're shy and don't compete much, they'll be more encouraged to show up here and challenge you for your title. Of-course, if you just vanish and don't compete at all, we'll have no choice but to strip you of your title in absentia and give it to whoever reaches the top of our leadership board. Now, how about eliminating a couple of mutants? We have regular shipments of some fresh specimens, half starved and super pissed off!

entries.JA_new: おめでとう、マークド・ワン！ついにチャンピオンだ！今のところ、お前に挑める奴はいない。だが時々は試合に出て、観客を沸かせた方がいい。姿を見せず、試合にも出なければ、挑戦者も増えるだろう。もっとも、完全に姿を消せば、チャンピオンの座を剥奪してランキングの頂点にいる奴へ渡すしかないがな。さて、ミュータントを何匹か片づけてみるか？腹を空かせて、殺気立った新顔が定期的に届くんだ！

entries.EN: So, Marked One, today we have two exclusive fights to watch: the Military versus the Mercs and the "Duty" against the "Freedom". There will be six combatants on each side, very skilled fighters all of them and all of them are armed accordingly. The winners will reach the final, where they will fight for the title of the toughest faction of the week and get some privileges. The victory is a matter of principle for every faction, so they will fight like hell. Be sure to bet wisely.

entries.EN: Excellent, Marked One. As you see, the Arena is ready to absorb some fresh blood. Come on, choose the fight! We've got an intense program for today, as always.

entries.JA_new: いいぞ、マークド・ワン。見ての通り、アリーナは新しい血を待ってる。さあ、試合を選べ！今日も熱い試合を用意してあるぞ。

entries.JA_new: よく聞け！

entries.EN: Got it. Anything else?

entries.JA_new: 分かった。他には？

entries.EN: The war with the Freedom is going to end soon. You've contributed a lot to our common goal and you may become our brother. Are you ready to swear the oath?
entries.JA_current: The war with the Freedom is going to end soon. You've contributed a lot to our common goal and you may become our brother. Are you ready to swear the oath?
entries.JA_new: フリーダムとの戦争も、もうすぐ終わる。お前は共通の目標に大きく貢献してくれた。俺たちの兄弟になれるかもしれん。誓いを立てる覚悟はあるか？

entries.EN: Yep, I have. At my expense today. But remember: the first drink to Serene.
entries.JA_current: Yep, I have. At my expense today. But remember: the first drink to Serene.
entries.JA_new: ああ、あるぞ。今日は俺のおごりだ。ただし、最初の一杯はセリーンに捧げてくれ。

entries.EN: Drink to who?
entries.JA_current: Drink to who?
entries.JA_new: 誰に捧げるって？

entries.EN: Hey, have you never heard about Serene?
entries.JA_current: Hey, have you never heard about Serene?
entries.JA_new: おい、セリーンのことを聞いたことないのか？

entries.EN: No, never... Who's he?
entries.JA_current: No, never... Who's he?
entries.JA_new: いや、初耳だ……誰なんだ？

entries.EN: Yeah, I've heard about him... Give me the beer!
entries.JA_current: Yeah, I've heard about him... Give me the beer!
entries.JA_new: ああ、聞いたことはある……ビールをくれ！

entries.EN: Respect to him and may his memory live forever! Give me the beer.
entries.JA_current: Respect to him and may his memory live forever! Give me the beer.
entries.JA_new: あの人に敬意を。いつまでも語り継がれますように！さあ、ビールをくれ。

entries.EN: Here, have it.
entries.JA_current: Here, have it.
entries.JA_new: ほら、持ってけ。

entries.EN: That's the spirit! The stalker's name is Basta. He left recently to join the scientists at Yantar. If you move out now, I think that's where you'll find him. Good luck!
entries.JA_current: That's the spirit! The stalker's name is Basta. He left recently to join the scientists at Yantar. If you move out now, I think that's where you'll find him. Good luck!
entries.JA_new: その意気だ！ストーカーの名はバスタ。少し前にヤンターの科学者たちのところへ向かった。今すぐ出れば、まだそこにいるはずだ。幸運を祈る！

entries.EN: I'll take a mine detector, if you have one. Who knows where the Zone will take me.
entries.JA_current: I'll take a mine detector, if you have one. Who knows where the Zone will take me.
entries.JA_new: 地雷探知機があれば譲ってくれ。ゾーンで何があるか分からないからな。

entries.EN: I can tell you're an experienced stalker.
entries.JA_current: I can tell you're an experienced stalker.
entries.JA_new: あんた、腕の立つストーカーだな。

entries.EN: I'm getting a jumpsuit.
entries.JA_current: I'm getting a jumpsuit.
entries.JA_new: つなぎを買うよ。

entries.EN: Who the hell are they?
entries.JA_current: Who the hell are they?
entries.JA_new: そいつらはいったい何者だ？

entries.EN: "Gladiators" are a gang that used to run with Borov. Caesar, Nero, and Caligula, as they are called. They are total scumbags, ex-athletes, ex-special forces - in short, very dangerous and completely insane. People say they've got a dozen life sentences between them outside the Zone, and even here they escaped death squads many times. In terms of racketeering they are also successful, most of the stalkers around here fear them and tend to just give up the loot if stopped by them.
entries.JA_current: "Gladiators" are a gang that used to run with Borov. Caesar, Nero, and Caligula, as they are called. They are total scumbags, ex-athletes, ex-special forces - in short, very dangerous and completely insane. People say they've got a dozen life sentences between them outside the Zone, and even here they escaped death squads many times. In terms of racketeering they are also successful, most of the stalkers around here fear them and tend to just give up the loot if stopped by them.
entries.JA_new: 「グラディエーター」は、昔ボロフとつるんでいたギャングだ。シーザー、ネロ、カリギュラと呼ばれてる連中だよ。元アスリートや元特殊部隊員のクズばかりで、危険なうえに完全にイカれてる。ゾーンの外では合わせて何十件も終身刑を食らってたって噂だし、こっちでも処刑隊から何度も逃げおおせてる。恐喝の腕も相当なもんで、この辺のストーカーは連中を恐れてる。出くわしたら、荷物を差し出してやり過ごす奴が多い。

entries.EN: I think I can negotiate with them.
entries.JA_current: I think I can negotiate with them.
entries.JA_new: 話をつけられると思う。

entries.EN: You're in trouble, man, I'm sorry...
entries.JA_current: You're in trouble, man, I'm sorry...
entries.JA_new: あんた、まずいことになったな……気の毒に。

entries.EN: Make a deal? What do you mean?
entries.JA_current: Make a deal? What do you mean?
entries.JA_new: 取引する？どういう意味だ？

entries.EN: "Only good bandit is a dead bandit" - get the picture?
entries.JA_current: "Only good bandit is a dead bandit" - get the picture?
entries.JA_new: 「いいバンディットは死んだバンディットだけ」ってことだ。分かるだろ？

entries.EN: Well, Joseph Stalin over here, so... Are you planning to kill them?
entries.JA_current: Well, Joseph Stalin over here, so... Are you planning to kill them?
entries.JA_new: おや、スターリン同志のお出ましか……そいつらを殺す気か？

entries.EN: Sort of.
entries.JA_current: Sort of.
entries.JA_new: まあ、そんなところだ。

entries.EN: You're a brave man! Look, if you take them down... Just think how many stalkers would thank you for it. Shame you probably won't make it, you're not the first hotshot who decided to hit them.
entries.JA_current: You're a brave man! Look, if you take them down... Just think how many stalkers would thank you for it. Shame you probably won't make it, you're not the first hotshot who decided to hit them.
entries.JA_new: 肝が据わってるな！奴らを始末できれば……何人のストーカーが感謝するか考えてみろ。まあ、生きて帰れるとは思えないがな。あいつらを狙った命知らずは、あんたが初めてじゃない。

entries.EN: We'll see.
entries.JA_current: We'll see.
entries.JA_new: どうなるか見てみよう。
